ambient_events: A tap drips into a rust-streaked basin, three seconds apart, forever.
The hand dryer kicks on by itself for no one, then gives up.
description: A single-stall washroom off the lobby, cracked subway tile and a mirror gone cloudy at the edges. The lock on the stall door is a bent nail wedged in a hole where the real one used to be. Someone's scratched a room number into the paint by the sink, long since crossed out. It smells like old plumbing and Lowry's cheap soap, refilled from a bulk jug behind the bar.

flags.intro_lore: The Embassy's one shared washroom, same age as the lobby carpet and holding up about as well. Guests share it, Lowry restocks the soap when he remembers, and the lock's a formality more than a promise.

name: Embassy Hotel & Bar — Washroom
